scenario.summary: Threat actors use Microsoft Teams to impersonate helpdesk personnel, tricking users into allowing remote control and installing a persistent Node.js implant. This implant enables persistent command-and-control, host discovery, and lateral movement via WinRM toward high-value infrastructure.

meta.rationale: Focus on hosts where users have LocalAppData execution rights and where external Microsoft Teams collaboration is permitted.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder is maintaining interactive control via a Node.js implant staged in a user profile, performing Active Directory reconnaissance and moving laterally via WinRM.

hunt.name: Persistent Node.js Backdoor Activity
hunt.description: This hunt targets the post-exploitation behavior of an adversary who has gained access through social engineering. It focuses on the unusual execution of a legitimate Node.js runtime from LocalAppData, a pattern used to evade binary-based detections. The hunt correlates this execution with rare file paths, reconnaissance-themed script blocks (ADSI, AV/VM discovery), and internal network pivoting over the WinRM protocol to identify hands-on-keyboard activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\appdata\local\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\users\%\appdata\%') AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%node.exe' OR LOWER(process_original_file_name) = 'node.exe') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts where the Node.js runtime or renamed copies are executing from LocalAppData, which is the primary execution pattern for this implant.
config.expected_signal: Hosts where Node.js is running from a user profile. Legitimate development often uses specific paths; outliers here warrant investigation.

primitive_config.label: Node.js execution from user-writable paths

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\appdata\local\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\users\%\appdata\%') AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%node.exe' OR LOWER(process_original_file_name) = 'node.exe') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY path HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Stack-count the execution paths to find rare, randomly named directories used for implant staging.
config.expected_signal: A path seen on only one or two hosts, which is highly characteristic of the randomly named staging directories in this campaign.

primitive_config.label: Prevalence of Node.js execution paths

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_path, script_content, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%adsisearcher%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%antivirusproduct%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%win32_videocontroller%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, direction, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%node.exe' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\appdata\local\%') AND dst_endpoint_port = 5985 AND direction = 'outbound' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify internal connections on port 5985, which the operator uses to pivot from the beachhead toward identity servers.
config.expected_signal: A Node.js process initiating WinRM connections to other internal hosts. This confirms lateral movement intent.
